title: Chandra Chakori
desc: Puttaraju and Sevanthi fall in love with each other. Sevanthi's father puts forth a condition for their marriage which Puttaraju must fulfil.

title: Solillada Saradara
desc: Krishna, a ferry driver, is about to marry Rukmini, the love of his life. However, things take a turn when a landlord's daughter falls for him.

title: Moggina Manasu
desc: Renu, Akka, Didi and Chanchala are four friends from college who face several adversities in life. However, they find one way or another to live their life to the fullest.

title: Neenello Naanalle
desc: Santosh meets a charming village girl and ends up falling for her when he returns to India with his mother for a wedding.
